python3 - <<'PY'
import base64,gzip,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
parts=[]
for ident in ['yz-cairn-r47c-saas-csv-20260923-source-1', 'yz-cairn-r47c-saas-csv-20260923-source-2', 'yz-cairn-r47c-saas-csv-20260923-source-3', 'yz-cairn-r47c-saas-csv-20260923-source-4b']:
    text=(Path('p')/(ident+'.md')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    head,sep,body=text.partition('\
---\
')
    if not sep: raise SystemExit('Source part has no record delimiter: '+ident)
    marker,sep,encoded=body.strip().partition('\
')
    if not marker.startswith('GZIP_BASE64_PART ') or not sep:
        raise SystemExit('Source part has no data marker: '+ident)
    parts.append(encoded.strip()
patch=gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(''.join(parts),altchars=b'-_',validate=True))
if hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest()!='f23745d72f86cfd9f953f93eaa3095235e07365596326a2f0603f842417f0924':
    raise SystemExit('Source transport mismatch; no repository file changed')
subprocess.run(['git','apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],input=patch,check=True)
guide=Path('commercial/saas-migration-parity-pilot/CSV_INTAKE.md')
with guide.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as out:
    out.write('\
## Alongside the browser workbench\
\
'
              'The browser workflow from #19291 remains available through `workbench.py`; '
              'see [WORKBENCH.md](WORKBENCH.md). This headless route adds saved mapping plans, '
              'literal header aliases, alternate delimiters and per-export boolean tokens. '
              'Both routes call the same parity engine and produce its manifest/report formats. '
              'The CSV mapping-plan JSON is not a workbench request; no automatic plan exchange '
              'or identical blank-cell policy between the two intake interfaces is claimed.\
')
print('Applied headless CSV intake and operator guide beside #19291. Existing browser and comparison engine unchanged. No tests run.')
PY"}
